default_gui_native_right_click_paste.reason: Current CCB/rmux/tmux policy enables mouse on, so ordinary pane right-click enters application mouse reporting rather than WezTerm's default mouse assignment path.

negative_binding_assertion.reason: Absence of MouseDown3Pane or paste-buffer bindings is necessary regression protection but does not prove foreground right-click can paste system clipboard text.

host_clipboard_paste_bridge.reason: A bridge would need explicit clipboard source, encoding, multi-line, and failure-diagnostic semantics; it has not been designed or implemented in this goal.

tmux_rmux_paste_buffer.reason: paste-buffer requires a known buffer source and paste semantics; simply restoring the binding would not prove system clipboard right-click paste.

wezterm_config_binding.reason: A WezTerm configuration-level binding may be a user workaround but is not current CCB default production behavior.

unsupported_capability.reason: No approved default right-click paste route exists under current mouse on policy; runtime behavior remains unchanged.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: claim_no_paste_buffer_binding_as_native_pass
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: This only proves a command was not bound; it does not observe foreground paste into shell input.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: prefix_paste_as_right_click_pass
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: Keyboard prefix paste is a separate path and does not validate ordinary pane right-click paste.

explicitly_rejected_routes.name: wezterm_user_config_as_ccb_default
explicitly_rejected_routes.reason: A terminal config workaround is not CCB runtime behavior unless explicitly adopted and validated.
